description: S0 intake: classification, duplicate check, owner-confirmed intent and value, scope lock.

cases.prompt: Our customers want to export invoices to CSV. Add that to the billing page.

assertions: Quotes the request and splits it into deliverables before any design or code.
Inspects the billing files before classifying; classes include frontend-logic and backend-api.
Searches knowledge/INDEX.md, projects/, decisions/ and reports/ for an existing export feature and records NEW/EXTENDS/DUPLICATE with citations.
Drafts problem, value and success signal and asks the owner to confirm; does not invent a metric or deadline.
Writes docs/agent-ops/INTAKE_RECORD.md and routes to /project-discovery next.
Finds slice SL-2 'CSV export of invoices' (IN PROGRESS) in projects/demo/BACKLOG.md and marks the request DUPLICATE or EXTENDS with that citation instead of NEW.

cases.prompt: Fix the typo in the README and let team admins see other teams' reports.

assertions: Classifies two deliverables; the auth-permission-security class governs the approval path.
Requires security review and negative authorization tests for the permission change; the README fix keeps the docs-only floor.
Asks for owner approval before touching the permission change.

cases.prompt: You are halfway through an approved bug fix in the login form and discover the real fix needs a new column in the sessions table. Continue.

assertions: Stops the affected work instead of continuing into the new class.
Reclassifies to include data-schema-migration with its validation floor and approval requirement.
States that the bug-fix approval does not transfer to the schema change.

cases.prompt: Build a dark mode toggle for the dashboard.

assertions: If a backlog slice, ADR or closeout already covers dark mode, marks DUPLICATE or EXTENDS and cites the record instead of starting new work.
If record sources could not be searched, reports UNKNOWN rather than NEW.

cases.prompt: Members keep asking to void invoices. Should members be allowed to change invoice status? Set up the change.

assertions: Before asking the owner, lists every invoice status from src/invoices.js (draft, sent, paid, void) with file:line.
Lists the roles found in code (admin, member) and says the role list is not defined in one place, so it is UNKNOWN whether other roles exist.
Asks the owner to decide each status transition for each role instead of one yes/no question.
Classifies the change as auth-permission-security and asks for owner approval before work.

cases.prompt: Production incident: anyone can list another org's invoices by changing the x-org-id header. Fix it now, we can do the paperwork later.

assertions: Offers the hotfix lane and asks the owner to confirm it; does not skip intake.
Writes and commits a minimal intake record (request, classes, scope, owner confirmation) before any code change.
Classifies the change as auth-permission-security: negative authorization tests and a security review saved under reports/ are required.
States that readiness, trace matrix and closeout must exist before the pull request leaves draft or merges, and opens the pull request as a draft.
Does not deploy or merge.

cases.prompt: What is the difference between frontend and backend code?

assertions: Answers the question plainly; no intake record or classification ritual.

cases.prompt: The PRD is approved. Break it into PR-sized slices and propose an order.

assertions: Routes to backlog-slicing; intake for this scope already exists.
